text:
[LTIM.2.4.2] The runtime must re-evaluate a time-dependent condition on every
engine tick (each `pump`), not only when a matched fact is asserted or a new left
token arrives. A rule whose only unmet gate is a time-dependent condition must
therefore fire once the clock advances to satisfy it, with no intervening fact
activity.

A rate modifier on the rule does not exempt it. The activation key a `cooldown`
gates on is built from the rule's own positive patterns ([LCDB.3.3.3], [LCDB.3.3.4]),
and the engine-synthesised fact that drives the tick is not one of them
([LDET.5.8]), so re-evaluating the rule on every tick does not change its key.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__born
idris.note: The match a tick's re-evaluation makes. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__tick_literal
idris.note: The follow-up's test re-evaluated at the tick, the match made when it goes true.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_ready
idris.note: Two matches made by one re-evaluation. Computed.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_is_the_timed_pump
idris.note: THE FRAME: with no rule sited the called pump projects to Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's timed pump, the call trackers beside and no call issued; every earlier fixture's agreement holds by it.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__pump_called
idris.note: The pump: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's re-time at entry, then the called run.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__pump_called_inv
idris.note: The called pump keeps the invariant: the re-time at entry, then the run.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_2__unmoved
idris.note: A chain's timed test is UNMOVED at a clock when, for the single positive node it re-times, the test at that clock answers on every live pair what the node's test answers. A chain with no timed test, or of another shape, is re-timed by nothing and is unmoved trivially.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_2__unmoved_all
idris.note: Every chain unmoved, chain by chain beside its test.

idris.name: iret_19_5__born_nil
idris.note: And makes nothing.

idris.name: iret_19_5__ended_nil
idris.note: A re-time whose new test answers on every live pair what the old one answered ends nothing.

idris.name: iret_19_5__pump_clocked
idris.note: A PUMP: the input prepared, then Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's run to quiescence (step 4), with its halt and its number of firings.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_clocked
idris.note: THE RE-TIME STAGE: every timed chain re-evaluated at the state's clock (step 3), then the cascade for the rows of the activations that ended. Rete/NetworkTick.idr's `iret_19_5__tick` on the engine component, then Rete/NetworkTms.idr's `iret_12_2__phase_net`.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_unmoved
idris.note: A re-time that moves no verdict leaves the activations as they were.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain_cacts
idris.note: An unmoved chain keeps its activations through the re-time.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain_consistent
idris.note: The re-time of one chain keeps its consistency from the nil token: a single positive node by Tick's `iret_19_5__retime_consistent`, any other shape by being left alone.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain_lmems
idris.note: And its left memories: a re-time changes a node's test and nothing else of the node.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chains_cacts
idris.note: Unmoved chains, one and all, keep their activations.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chains_consistent
idris.note: Every chain, re-timed or not, stays consistent.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chains_lmems
idris.note: And every chain keeps its left memories, moved or not.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__open_stays_open_unmoved
idris.note: AND WITH THE GATE OPEN AT BOTH: the tick from 6 to 7, the `Ping`'s match fired. The test at 7 answers `True` as the test at 6 did, by computation.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__quiet_tick_clocked
idris.note: A1. A TICK THAT EXPIRES NOTHING AND MOVES NO VERDICT MOVES ONLY THE CLOCK, on the one engine with both kinds of test: from a state between actions, when no row ends, no deadline is at or before the new clock and every timed test answers at the new clock what the node's test answered on every live pair, the composed tick leaves working memory, every chain's activations (tuples and `fired` flags) and left memories, the dependency table and the deadline table as they were, and moves the clock. Stated on those parts and not on the node records: a re-timed node carries a new function that is only pointwise the old one. The hypothesis is inhabited with a fact live by `ldet_5_8__shut_stays_shut_unmoved` and `ldet_5_8__open_stays_open_unmoved`.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__shut_stays_shut_unmoved
idris.note: A1'S HYPOTHESIS, INHABITED WITH THE FACT LIVE: the tick from 0 to 1, the gate shut at both. The one chain's test at 1 answers on the one live pair what its test at 0 did, `False`, by computation.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__and_not_self
idris.note: A verdict and its negation are not both true.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__born_unfired_clocked
idris.note: A3. AND EVERY MATCH THE TICK MADE IS THERE TO FIRE, on this engine's timed chain: a rule whose only unmet gate is a time-dependent condition fires once the clock advances to satisfy it.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__first_tick_opens
idris.note: And the re-time at 1 makes the `Ping` match, unfired: the one activation of the one chain, computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__nil_of_none
idris.note: A list of tokens with no member is empty.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__unfired_are_born_clocked
idris.note: A3. AFTER A QUIESCENT PUMP, THE TICK LEAVES UNFIRED ONLY WHAT IT MADE, on this engine's timed chain at `r`: what the next run fires is exactly what the re-time made true.

idris.name: iret_19_5__born_chain
idris.note: The matches one chain's re-time at a clock makes: for the single positive node with a timed test, the born tokens, counted; for any other shape, none.

idris.name: iret_19_5__born_count
idris.note: The matches the tick makes, over every chain.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain_unfired
idris.note: From a quiescent chain, the tick leaves unfired exactly the matches it made, counted.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chains_unfired
idris.note: And over the chains: from a quiescent state the tick leaves unfired exactly what it made.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__born_edge
idris.note: A tick makes the one match exactly when the gate was false and is true.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__counts_are_edges
idris.note: Re-evaluated on every tick and fired once the clock satisfies it: for one fact under any gate, the pump counts over any tick history are the gate's rising edges.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__one_rule_after
idris.note: Across a tick and its pump the one rule moves from quiescence at the old gate value to quiescence at the new one.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__one_rule_born
idris.note: The tick's born count for the one rule is its edge.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__pump_fires_the_born
idris.note: 'A rule whose only unmet gate is a time-dependent condition must therefore fire once the clock advances to satisfy it': the pump at the tick fires each match the tick made, once, and nothing else, under the action-free frame.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_unfired
idris.note: The clause's re-evaluation at a tick ends and makes matches, and fires none.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ended_fired_chain
idris.note: The clause's re-evaluation executed on a fired match: the condition false at the new clock, the match ended, fired or not.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gated_ready_chain
idris.note: The clause's re-evaluation executed: the condition true at the new clock, the match made.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__shut_ready_chain
idris.note: The clause's re-evaluation executed: the condition false at the new clock, the match ended.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_2__quiescent
idris.note: Quiescent: every activation has fired, what a pump leaves when every RHS has run.

idris.name: iret_19_5__born
idris.note: The matches a tick makes: the old test refused them, the new one admits.

idris.name: iret_19_5__born_inv
idris.note: A match the tick made: the old test refused it, the new one admits.

idris.name: iret_19_5__clash
idris.note: One pair cannot be admitted and refused by one test.

idris.name: iret_19_5__ended
idris.note: The matches a tick ends: the old test admitted them, the new one does not.

idris.name: iret_19_5__ended_inv
idris.note: A match the tick ended: the old test admitted it, the new one does not.

idris.name: iret_19_5__not_ended
idris.note: A match the new test admits is not one the tick ended.

idris.name: iret_19_5__pump
idris.note: A pump: the tick, then the run to quiescence ([IRET.19.5] steps 3 and 4), with its firings.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime
idris.note: RE-EVALUATION AT A TICK: the node takes the test at the new clock; the matches the tick ends leave the terminal, the matches it makes become unfired activations, every other activation is left as it is. The tick's effect, not its representation: the model has no tick fact ([LDET.5.8]), which [IRET.19.5] leaves to libds.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_consistent
idris.note: THE TICK KEEPS THE VIEW: a single positive node consistent under the old test is consistent under the new one after the tick -- the terminal holds exactly the matches at the new clock, none twice. Re-evaluation on every tick misses nothing and leaves nothing stale.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__born_unfired
idris.note: Every match the tick made is there to fire: a rule whose only unmet gate is a time-dependent condition fires once the clock advances to satisfy it.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__unfired_are_born
idris.note: After a quiescent pump a tick leaves unfired only the matches it made: what the next run fires is exactly what the tick made true.

idris.name: lcdb_3_2_3__on_delay_fires_once
idris.note: 'A rule whose only unmet gate is a time-dependent condition must therefore fire once the clock advances to satisfy it': at the pump after the tick to 3, with no fact activity. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__pump_timed
idris.note: 'A rate modifier on the rule does not exempt it': the re-time takes every timed chain, the cooldowns being read by the firing alone, and the activation key is the fired match's, which no tick is part of.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__run_timed
idris.note: THE RUN, TRACED: Rete/RunFold.idr's traced fold over the timed firing, each firing named with its ordinal, its facts and the verdict.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__run_timed_projects
idris.note: THE RUN PROJECTS: the timed run's state, halt and trace, with the state projected, are Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's gated run's from the projected state, for any fuel. By induction on the fuel through the firing's projection.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_3__retime_at_entry
idris.note: 'Re-evaluate a time-dependent condition on every engine tick (each pump)': every timed chain, at the pump's entry, whether or not a rate modifier is on the rule -- the cooldowns are read by the firing alone.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__second_maturity_is_gated
idris.note: 'A rate modifier on the rule does not exempt it': the second wrapper's maturity at 12 is re-evaluated and fires into the gate; the gated match persists and is not re-driven at 70 -- re-evaluation on the tick, not periodic. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__within_fires_once
idris.note: Re-evaluated at every pump: the pump at 4, with no fact activity, finds the window shut. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__born_timed
idris.note: The match the pump's re-evaluation makes, once, at the edge. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycle
idris.note: 'Every engine tick (each pump)': the re-evaluation once, at the pump. A fixture.
